cases.name: orbital salvage manifest
cases.prompt: Build an orbital salvage manifest service. The orbital salvage coordinators register recovery capsules, trajectory analysts validate decay windows, and archive officers issue a handoff manifest. Track capsule status from located to sealed. A capsule may transfer only after a signed radiation survey. Use the public ephemeris relay. Retain survey provenance for twelve years. Do not reveal crew medical notes. The first path begins with capsule registration.

cases.name: canal lock maintenance dispatch
cases.prompt: Edited request: make the canal-lock dispatch board for lock tenders. Start with inspection tickets, then route a ticket to a mechanic, and produce a repair clearance. The ticket state is queued, assigned, repaired, or cleared. It depends on the harbor notice API. Keep gate serials attached to every clearance. Earlier draft said a tender may clear a repair alone; replace that rule: a hydraulic inspector must clear every repair. Never schedule a lock opening while a ticket is assigned.

cases.name: alpine refuge cache
cases.prompt:

- Users: refuge wardens and rescue dispatchers
- Need: log emergency cache inspections in CairnSignal
- State: stocked, inspected, depleted, inaccessible
- Output: a cache readiness slip

- Safety: do not infer inventory from a previous season

cases.name: marsh specimen loan
cases.prompt: Research extract A: the Fenwick marsh collection lends sediment cores to laboratories and must preserve borrower, borehole, and temperature-chain evidence. Research extract B: a loan certificate is issued only after a conservator confirms the core sleeve. Build the product for collection lenders. The state is requested, packed, in transit, returned, or quarantined. Integrate with ColdTrace courier events. Do not permit a returned core into storage until its arrival temperature is reconciled. The request never says whether the lender or the receiving laboratory owns the quarantine decision.

cases.name: theater flame prop register
cases.prompt: Create a compact register for theater safety captains to certify flame-effect props. Captains record prop serial, fuel class, and rehearsal slot; stage managers request activation; the system outputs an activation card. States are cataloged, inspected, approved, active, and retired. Approval requires a fire marshal acknowledgment from EmberPermit. Keep the acknowledgment receipt. Must not use performer names in the register. First path: catalog a prop.

cases.name: district heat outage ledger
cases.prompt: Build a district-heat outage ledger. Service operators open an incident, field valves crews log isolation work, and tenant liaisons receive a restoration bulletin. Track incident state as reported, isolated, cooling, restored, or closed. A bulletin is published after a control-room supervisor approves the restoration reading. Pull pressure samples from ThermoGrid. Preserve the original reading and any correction. Do not calculate household compensation. The first path is incident intake.

cases.name: fragrance archive access
cases.prompt: Edited confirmation: preserve formula cards and vapor-capture scans for the scent archive. Curators admit a vial, chemists assess stability, and access stewards issue a viewing permit. The output is a restricted-access dossier. States: received, stabilizing, cleared, restricted, withdrawn. It depends on the AromaVault identity service. A curator must attach a donor-use restriction before a vial is cleared. Earlier note requested public scent samples; remove it. Do not publish formulas or donor identities. The prompt does not state whether a chemist or an access steward may withdraw a vial.

cases.name: floodgate telemetry review
cases.prompt: Brief // Product: floodgate telemetry review // Actors: river controllers, instrumentation engineers // Action: review actuator traces // State: fresh, delayed, suspect, confirmed // Output: gate-operating notice // Dependency: GaugeMesh event stream // Constraint: an engineer confirms a suspect trace before a controller changes a gate setting // Non-goal: never turn a missing trace into a normal reading // First path: ingest a trace.

cases.name: street organ tuning route
cases.prompt: Source notes say traveling organ tuners need routes for municipal instruments, keeping reed measurements, weather, and permit windows together. Build the service for tuning leads. A route becomes ready after the venue custodian accepts the access window, and it produces a tuning itinerary. States are drafted, measured, awaiting access, ready, and completed. Read permit windows from CivicKey. Do not replace a measured pitch with a guessed value. Assume each organ has one municipal asset number. Begin by recording a reed measurement.

cases.name: urban bat roost permit
cases.prompt: Make an urban bat-roost permit tracker. The urban bat-roost monitors submit a roost observation, ecologists verify species evidence, and permit clerks release a work-window permit. States are observed, verified, pending permit, permitted, and expired. The permit cannot issue until the ecologist signs the evidence packet. Query the municipal habitat registry. Retain acoustic clips for three migration cycles. Do not expose building resident contacts. First path: submit an observation.

cases.name: ice road load bulletin
cases.prompt: Research memo: northern depot planners coordinate ice-road load bulletins using BorealRoute. Drivers file axle readings; surveyors certify thickness; dispatch leads issue a load bulletin. The condition states are unmeasured, measured, restricted, released, and closed. A release needs both a current thickness certificate and a dispatch approval. Preserve each certificate revision. Do not treat last week's thickness as current. One passage says releases require two surveyors; a later passage says one surveyor is sufficient, without saying which rule supersedes the other.

cases.name: restoration nursery provenance
cases.prompt: Create a provenance notebook for wetland-restoration nurseries. Nursery stewards log seed trays, geneticists validate source lots, and planting crews receive a release label. Track a tray as sown, sampled, cleared, planted, or discarded. A label requires a validated source lot and a phytosanitary pass from PlantPass. Keep seed-collection coordinates at watershed precision. Never infer a source lot from a tray nickname. First path starts with tray intake.

cases.name: museum light exposure log

cases.name: harbor dredging sound watch
cases.prompt: Build a sound-watch product for harbor dredging work. The harbor dredging observers tag hydrophone intervals, marine biologists assess protected-species signals, and operations leads issue a pause notice. States are captured, screened, flagged, confirmed, and closed. A pause notice requires a confirmed signal and a timestamp from PelagicClock. Retain raw interval hashes. Do not identify individual vessel crews. The first path is hydrophone intake. The request is silent about who can reopen a closed event.

cases.name: ambulance equipment seal
cases.prompt: Thin request: track ambulance equipment seals across the fleet. The fleet quartermasters register kits, paramedics report a broken seal, and compliance nurses issue a service-ready tag. Status is sealed, opened, replenishing, checked, or service-ready. A tag depends on a nurse verification in MedSeal Connect. Preserve kit serial and check time. Do not infer the contents of an opened kit. Start with kit registration.

cases.name: foundry mold release
cases.prompt: Edited job ticket: run mold-release checks for civic foundry patterns. Pattern keepers create a mold record; metallurgists approve alloy compatibility; casting foremen publish a pour release. State changes are drafted, matched, approved, poured, and archived. The release needs a compatibility report from AlloyIndex. Preserve the pattern revision and sand batch. Earlier request allowed a foreman to approve compatibility; that authorization is withdrawn. No pour release may proceed without metallurgist approval. Do not combine reports from different alloy heats.

cases.name: community radio archive
cases.prompt: Evidence bundle: volunteer radio archivists ingest cassette programs, rights coordinators verify permissions, and station editors publish a listening notice. The archive tracks received, digitized, rights-pending, cleared, and embargoed records. It must issue a listening notice only after a rights clearance from RightsHarbor. Retain the digitization checksum. Must not publish caller telephone numbers. Assume the station identifier is stable across a program's segments. First path is cassette intake.

cases.name: seismic sensor relocation
cases.prompt: Build a relocation planner for seismic sensors. The seismic sensor custodians propose a move, geophysicists approve a site model, and field crews receive an installation packet. States are proposed, surveyed, approved, installed, and verified. An installation packet requires a site model approval and a clearance from LandLink. Keep latitude, longitude, and instrument serial in the packet. Never fabricate a coordinate. The first path starts with a move proposal. The prompt says a field crew or a custodian records the final verification, but gives no rule to choose between them.

cases.name: lighthouse lens service
cases.prompt: Brief: lighthouse lens service. Lens keepers log cleaning work, optical engineers certify alignment, and maritime clerks issue a service attestation. State model: logged, cleaning, aligned, certified, deferred. Dependency: BeaconNet weather notice. Constraint: an engineer certifies alignment before attestation. Preserve before-and-after alignment readings. Non-goal: do not erase a deferred service reason. First path: log cleaning work.

cases.name: school meal allergen handoff
cases.prompt: Create a handoff register for school meal allergen coordinators. Dietitians define ingredient restrictions, kitchen leads assemble a service batch, and campus nurses approve a meal handoff card. States are drafted, checked, assembled, handed off, and recalled. A card requires ingredient data from PantryGraph and nurse approval. Keep supplier lot references with the batch. Do not expose a pupil's diagnosis. First path is restriction entry. The request has no contradiction: it expressly says a campus nurse owns the approval.

cases.name: volcanic ash sampler
cases.prompt: Research summary for aviation ash sampling: flight observers request sampler deployment, laboratory mineralogists validate filters, and flight safety officers issue an exposure advisory. Track requested, deployed, received, validated, and advised states. The advisory requires a validated filter report and plume coordinates from AshMap. Retain the filter custody chain. Do not turn an estimated plume edge into a measured coordinate. cases.name: public fountain chemistry

States are sampled, pending analysis, adjusted, cleared, and reopened. The notice needs a cleared analysis from AquaLedger. Store reagent lot and calibration time. Original draft said to retain visitor photographs; delete that requirement because photographs are outside scope. Do not label water safe without an analysis. First path: take a sample.
